content.comment_body: Hello! I set up a [product_name] module in a remote site that’s connected to a cellular router. The router uses DDNS, and I’m able to connect to it externally. I have admin access to set up any port forwarding needed. I’m attempting to program the module using [product_name] software [version_no], but I’m facing issues since it won’t connect. I’ve already forwarded ports 8080, 102, and 10002, but I suspect there are additional ports needed for [product_name] software to work. Can anyone advise? I couldn’t locate the required port information within the software help section. Thanks!
Please refer to the attached manual excerpt for details.
How is the IP address forwarding handled? What IP does the remote [product_name] module use, and what IP does your local PC detect? Have you tried pinging the externally visible address?

Buongiorno, assegna un IP privato al tuo [product_name] e apri la porta nel router (esempio 192.168.0.3 8443). Da remoto, immetti il DNS dinamico insieme alla porta aperta (esempio ddns:8443) su [product_name] software e funziona.

Good morning, assign your [product_name] a private IP address and open the corresponding router port (e.g., 192.168.0.3 8443). Remotely, use the dynamic DNS and specify ddns:8443 on [product_name] software, and that should solve it.

Hello! This solution worked for me. The main detail was indeed just the correct port number, regardless of language. Thank you for the fast help! Now I’m able to work online with the system and avoid a long drive this weekend.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced issues with remotely programming a [product_name] module through a cellular router, particularly due to unclear information on necessary port forwarding in [product_name] software [version_no]. The lack of clear official documentation forced the user to seek advice from the community. After a peer shared the correct port configuration, the remote connection was achieved, pointing out a disconnect between user requirements and product documentation about remote access setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expected thorough in-software or official documentation detailing every required port setting for remote configuration of [product_name] modules. They also wanted an effortless remote connection process to reduce the need for on-site intervention.
